parameters.name: AddressType
parameters.description:
The address type. Valid values:

- `Internet`: A public address.

- `Intranet`: A private address.

parameters.name: CertId
parameters.description:
The ID of the **CLB** certificate.

- If `LoadBalanceType` is set to `clb`, use this parameter to configure the HTTPS listener certificate.

For more information about how to use SSL certificate IDs for CLB, see [Manage Certificates (CLB)](~~90792~~).

parameters.name: CertIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the **ALB** certificates.

- If `LoadBalanceType` is set to `alb`, use this parameter to configure multiple certificates for the HTTPS listener. Separate multiple certificate IDs with a comma (,).

- Obtain the SSL certificate ID for an ALB instance from the digital certificate service. For example, if you configure `756***-cn-hangzhou`, `756***` is the certificate ID obtained from the product page and `-cn-hangzhou` is a fixed suffix. For more information, see [Manage Certificates (ALB)](~~209076~~).

parameters.name: CorsConfig
parameters.description: Specifies the Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration.

parameters.name: DefaultRule
parameters.description:
The default forwarding rule. Requests that do not match any forwarding rule in the `Rules` parameter are forwarded to the application specified in this rule. The value is a JSON string with the following parameters:

- `appId`: The ID of the application.

- `containerPort`: The port of the application instance.

> This rule serves as a catch-all for traffic that is not handled by other specific forwarding rules.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The name of the routing rule.

parameters.name: EnableGzip
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable Gzip for data compression.

parameters.name: EnableXForwardedFor
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-For` header to retrieve the IP address of the client.

parameters.name: EnableXForwardedForClientSrcPort
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Port` header to retrieve the source port of the client.

parameters.name: EnableXForwardedForProto
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header to retrieve the listener protocol of the load balancer instance.

parameters.name: EnableXForwardedForSlbId
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the `SLB-ID` header to retrieve the ID of the load balancer instance.

parameters.name: EnableXForwardedForSlbPort
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Port` header to retrieve the listener port of the load balancer instance.

parameters.name: IdleTimeout
parameters.description: The connection idle timeout, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 60. If no request is received within the timeout period, the load balancer temporarily closes the connection. The connection is re-established when the next request is received.

parameters.name: ListenerPort
parameters.description: The listener port for the SLB instance. This port must be available.

parameters.name: ListenerProtocol
parameters.description:
The request forwarding protocol. Valid values:

- `HTTP`: for applications that do not require encryption.

- `HTTPS`: suitable for applications that require encrypted data transmission.

parameters.name: LoadBalanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance. This parameter cannot be changed after the routing rule is created. Valid values:

- `clb`: Classic Load Balancer (CLB), formerly known as SLB.

- `alb`: Application Load Balancer (ALB).

parameters.name: LoadBalancerEdition
parameters.description:
The edition of the Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance. Different editions have different features and billing policies. Valid values:

- `Standard`: Standard edition.

- `StandardWithWaf`: WAF-enhanced edition.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace where the application is located. Cross-namespace applications are not supported.

parameters.name: RequestTimeout
parameters.description: The request timeout, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 180. If a backend server does not respond within the timeout period, the load balancer stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error to the client.

parameters.name: Rules
parameters.description:
The forwarding rules. These rules route traffic to a specified application based on the domain name and path. The value is a JSON string. Each rule contains the following parameters:

- `appId`: The ID of the application.

- `containerPort`: The port of the application instance.

- `domain`: The domain name.

- `path`: The request path.

- `backendProtocol`: The protocol used by backend servers. Valid values: `http`, `https`, and `grpc`. Default value: `http`.

- `rewritePath`: The rewritten path.

> Only ALB supports path rewriting (`RewritePath`). CLB does not support this feature.

parameters.name: SecurityPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the security policy instance.

parameters.name: SlbId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance associated with the routing rule.

> Server Load Balancer (SLB) includes Classic Load Balancer (CLB) and Application Load Balancer (ALB) instances.

parameters.name: ZoneMappings
parameters.description:
A JSON string that contains the mappings between availability zones and VSwitches. If the current region supports two or more availability zones, you must specify at least two. A ZoneMapping consists of the following parameters:

- `VSwitchId`: a string that specifies the ID of the VSwitch that corresponds to the availability zone. Each availability zone can have only one VSwitch and one subnet.

- `ZoneId`: a string that specifies the ID of the availability zone for the load balancer instance.
